outcome: Incidence of placenta accreta spectrum disorders
Diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum disorders using ultrasound and MRI
Management of placenta accreta spectrum disorders
finding: The guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for the screening, diagnosis, and management of placenta accreta spectrum disorders, emphasizing the importance of interdisciplinary team-based care and regionalized management to optimize outcomes for both mothers and infants.
mod_finding: The guideline recommends elective Caesarean section delivery around 34–36 weeks gestation for otherwise healthy women with no history of vaginal bleeding, and earlier for repeated episodes of antepartum hemorrhage or contractions, to reduce the risks of emergent unplanned surgery.
